def ui_text(text): if not text: return text
try: lang = env.user.lang or '' except Exception: lang = ''
if not lang.startswith('ar'): return text
if text in UI_TEXT_AR: return UI_TEXT_AR[text]
for source, target in UI_TEXT_AR.items(): if '%s' not in source: continue prefix, suffix = source.split('%s', 1) if text.startswith(prefix) and text.endswith(suffix): value = text[len(prefix):len(text) - len(suffix)] if suffix else text[len(prefix):] try: return target % value except Exception: return target
return text
def reload_request(request): view = env.ref('hr_recruitment_custom.view_required_document_submission_request_form_controlled', raise_if_not_found=False) action = { 'type': 'ir.actions.act_window', 'name': request.x_name or 'Required Document Submission Request', 'res_model': 'x_hr.applicant_required_document_submission_request', 'res_id': request.id, 'view_mode': 'form', 'target': 'current', } if view: action['views'] = [(view.id, 'form')] return action

synced_count = 0 linked_count = 0 missing_count = 0 latest_response_at = False
for request_line in request.x_line_ids: if request_line.x_state == 'cancelled': continue
submission = submission_model.search([ ('x_submission_request_line_id', '=', request_line.id), ('x_state', 'in', ['submitted', 'accepted', 'rejected', 'superseded']), ], order='x_reviewed_on desc, create_date desc, id desc', limit=1)
if not submission and request_line.x_checklist_line_id: submission = submission_model.search([ ('x_submission_request_id', '=', request.id), ('x_line_id', '=', request_line.x_checklist_line_id.id), ('x_state', 'in', ['submitted', 'accepted', 'rejected', 'superseded']), ], order='x_reviewed_on desc, create_date desc, id desc', limit=1)
if not submission and request_line.x_checklist_line_id: submission = submission_model.search([ ('x_source_reference', '=', str(request_line.id)), ('x_line_id', '=', request_line.x_checklist_line_id.id), ('x_state', 'in', ['submitted', 'accepted', 'rejected', 'superseded']), ], order='x_reviewed_on desc, create_date desc, id desc', limit=1)
if not submission: missing_count += 1 continue
submission_values = {} if not submission.x_submission_request_id: submission_values['x_submission_request_id'] = request.id if not submission.x_submission_request_line_id: submission_values['x_submission_request_line_id'] = request_line.id
if submission_values: submission.write(submission_values) linked_count += 1
line_state = 'submitted' if submission.x_state == 'accepted': line_state = 'accepted' elif submission.x_state == 'rejected': line_state = 'rejected' elif submission.x_state == 'superseded': line_state = 'submitted'
request_line_values = { 'x_state': line_state, 'x_latest_submission_id': submission.id, }
request_line.write(request_line_values) synced_count += 1
response_at = submission.create_date or submission.x_reviewed_on if response_at and (not latest_response_at or response_at > latest_response_at): latest_response_at = response_at
request_values = {} if latest_response_at: request_values['x_last_response_at'] = latest_response_at
if request_values: request.write(request_values)
request.message_post( body='Synced request lines from submissions. Synced: %s. Linked orphan submissions: %s. Missing submissions: %s.' % ( synced_count, linked_count, missing_count, ) )
if synced_count: action = { 'type': 'ir.actions.client', 'tag': 'display_notification', 'params': { 'title': ui_text('Request lines synced'), 'message': ui_text('Synced %s request line(s) from existing submissions.') % synced_count, 'type': 'success', 'sticky': False, } } else: action = { 'type': 'ir.actions.client', 'tag': 'display_notification', 'params': { 'title': ui_text('No submissions found'), 'message': ui_text('No matching submitted, accepted, or rejected evidence records were found for active request lines.'), 'type': 'warning', 'sticky': False, } }
if not action: request = records[:1].sudo() if records else False action = reload_request(request) if request else {'type': 'ir.actions.client', 'tag': 'reload'}
